subject: social
title: Supply and demand
instruction: Change the price of a mango. Watch how many buyers want and how many sellers offer.
intro: When price goes up, buyers want less and sellers offer more.

goals.text: Find a price where buyers want more than sellers offer (a shortage).
goals.say: At a low price, buyers want more than sellers offer.

goals.text: Find the price where buyers and sellers balance (equilibrium).
goals.say: At 10 rupees, 50 mangoes are wanted and 50 are offered. That is the equilibrium.
